settings.title: Settings
settings.interfaceHint: Device discovery, DLNA registration and cast links will use only the selected interface. On multi-homed or VPN machines, picking the wrong interface hides LAN devices.
cast.stopNotDelivered: Stopped locally, but {devices} did not confirm the stop command — playback may continue.
devices.selectDeviceHint: Choose a device to cast to

guard.prompt: Allow this device to cast to your computer?
update.title: Update Available
update.checkFailed: Check failed, please try again later
close.title: Minimize to Taskbar
close.message:
HanCast will minimize to the taskbar.
To fully exit, right-click the taskbar icon.
autostartPrompt.title: Enable auto start?
autostartPrompt.desc: HanCast will automatically run when your system starts, making it easy to cast anytime.
autostartPrompt.hint: You can also enable this later in Settings or the system tray
screencast.title: Screen Cast
screencast.noDevice: No online device found, refresh the list first
screencast.screenTip: With multiple displays, cast just one: "Full Screen" grabs the union of all monitors — squeezed image, higher bitrate, and older TVs may fail to decode it.
screencast.noSystemSound: No system audio device detected (Windows: Stereo Mix; macOS: install BlackHole and route output)
screencast.inviteLink: Invite link (watch in browser, no install)
screencast.inviteTip: Open this link on your LAN to watch. Up to 20 viewers.
screencast.dlnaTip: Streaming to TV via DLNA. Picture may take a few seconds (live latency is normal).
screencast.ffmpegMissing: FFmpeg not found, screen casting unavailable
logs.title: Runtime Logs
logs.hint: For troubleshooting: pick a module and level, then Refresh. Turn on DEBUG before reproducing the issue to capture device discovery and cast requests in full. Export saves the log file locally so you can send it to the developer.
logs.empty: No log entries match the filters
logs.truncated: Only the newest entries are shown
devices.addHint: Auto discovery relies on LAN multicast, which firewalls and security software often block (that is why Windows can find the Mac but not the other way round). Enter the address directly: a device IP (e.g. 192.168.1.68), IP:port, or the full description.xml link from the device page. Added devices are remembered and reconnected on startup.
devices.addressPlaceholder: Device IP / IP:port / full description.xml URL
devices.addFailed: Could not reach that address: check that the device is on, on the same subnet, and allows connections to its service port
screencast.noDeviceHint: No TV / big screen found? Add it by IP manually, and check both firewalls allow HanCast.
screencast.dlnaNoPull: The TV never fetched the playlist
screencast.dlnaLowBitrate: The TV is pulling the stream but can not keep up
